comments.author: allenzren
comments.body:
Hey! Sorry there was an issue with the code. I just updated the branch (also merged with the main branch). Basically the eval config was not compatible with evaluating pre-trained (not fine-tuned) policy, which seems what you were trying?

You can use the main branch now for eval, either evaluating pre-trained or fine-tuned policy. Just make sure to specify `ft_denoising_steps` to 0 if evaluating pre-trained policy, and to the correct number of denoising steps fine-tuned if evaluating fine-tuned policy. I added a note on this in the evaluation section of the README.

Also, I realize the zero success rate is expected --- there is no issue with running evaluation with pre-trained policy in kitchen, in the original main branch. There are four stages in the kitchen task, and if the policy completes all four, it receives a reward of 4 (1 for each stage). The curves in Fig. 6 of the paper shows the normalized score (out of 4), instead of the success rate. For example, below shows the results I just ran with the pre-trained policy in Kitchen-Complete in the updated main branch, and it shows an average reward of 2.675, which is a normalized score of 2.675/4=0.66875.
